newsitem.title: RWANDA: U.N. agency says 200,000 cross Rwanda border.
newsitem.headline: U.N. agency says 200,000 cross Rwanda border.

text.p: The U.N. refugee agency said on Saturday 200,000 Rwandan Hutus had crossed into Rwanda from Zaire since an exodus of refugees started on Friday.
"We estimate that up till this morning up to 200,000 had already crossed since this began yesterday," UNHCR spokesman Ray Wilkinson told Reuters.
"The last I heard from our people on the border two hours ago (1.20 p.m. local time, 1120 GMT) was that 15,000 were crossing every hour," Wilkinson said.
